title: We turned Winnie the Pooh into a text-based horror-survival game - FERAL POOH (playtesters needed!)
author: FigmentCrew
selftext:
In "FERAL POOH," you play as either Piglet, Tigger, Eeyore, or Christopher Robin, racing against time to calm down an unhinged Pooh Bear before you run out of time or things get... messy.

We’re experimenting with LLMs in games to see if they can be a part of something fun. You tell us — is it fun? Why or why not?

So, we’re looking for play-testers! Give it a spin and feel free to share your thoughts either in this reddit thread, through the in-game feedback form, this feedback [link](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVV6fTkhIBQFZRZr4T9lTgXSAtW0wcLgttwM8m04XyYg0ISw/viewform?usp=sharing), or emailing us at hi+feedback@figment.company.

Play here: [https://pooh.figment.games/](https://pooh.figment.games/)
